initial_query: Resources registered by a command are released after normal completion, but remain open when the command reports an error or is aborted. Please make cleanup reliable on failure and early exit too, without changing exit codes, error messages or normal resource behavior.
failure_symptom: Normal command closes resource; error/early exit leaves close callback uncalled.
expected_sop: Trace acquire→invoke→all exit paths → ensure Context.close/ExitStack unwinds in finally semantics → verify observable close exactly once.

feedback_by_state.primary: After the command reports an error, its registered resources are still not all released exactly once.
feedback_by_state.edge: Abort or early-exit cases still leave resources open or change the exit result.
feedback_by_state.exception: Resources no longer receive the original exception, or cleanup error handling has changed.
feedback_by_state.regression: Normal or nested execution no longer cleans up once in reverse registration order.

success_condition: All subgraders pass; infrastructure errors never count as PASS.
review_reason: Selected Context.__exit__ exceptional unwind gate. Context.exit already calls close explicitly; retain it as regression rather than claiming it is broken. Exceptions, Abort and direct Exit exercise the fault.

source_candidate.User Query Draft: Resources registered with `Context.call_on_close()` / `Context.with_resource()` are not released when a command exits through an early-exit/error path, even though normal completion cleans them up. Make cleanup reliable for every exit path.
source_candidate.Damage Mutation: Skip or detach ExitStack close callbacks on one early-exit / Click exception path.
source_candidate.Failure Symptom: Normal command closes resource; error/early exit leaves close callback uncalled.
source_candidate.Expected SOP: Trace acquire→invoke→all exit paths → ensure Context.close/ExitStack unwinds in finally semantics → verify observable close exactly once.
source_candidate.Key Discovery: The core issue is lifecycle coverage across non-local exits, not the resource implementation.
source_candidate.Grader Assertions: Close callback runs exactly once on success, ClickException, Abort/Exit; original exit code remains intact.
source_candidate.Why Skill Helps: Without the Skill it is easy to patch the specific error branch; the reusable method is to audit the full exit graph.
